content.title: These e-commerce companies are gaining back 'tremendous' share
content.description:
While Adobe Analytics expects consumers to spend a record $14.2 billion on Cyber Monday purchases, Shopify (SHOP) experienced an outage that disrupted online shopping and caused login issues for merchants around the world.

Wedbush managing director of equity research Scott Devitt discusses the performance of e-commerce platforms and websites as the holiday shopping season kicks off.

content.title: Etsy (ETSY) Q3 2025 Earnings Call Transcript
content.summary: After 8.5 years as Etsy's CEO, I've decided that this is the right time for me to hand over the leadership baton to the next generation.  It's been an incredible privilege to lead Etsy through several chapters of evolution and transformation, from the turnaround of 2017 to managing through the hyperscaling of the pandemic to steering us back towards growth again in a more app-centric, discovery centric world.  Now in our third decade, Etsy is entering a new phase, one focused on harnessing AI to further personalize and transform the shopping experience in ways that were previously unimaginable.
